    Proposition 4.14 for a scalar mesh category #

    prop:scalar-normalization (scalar-normalization.tex), for the deck grading of a scalar mesh category with at most one arrow between vertices and mesh data (in the application, k(Γ_A) with arMeshData). The cover L of the projective labels is thin with a multiplicative basis (Lemmas 4.8–4.12), the deck group is free (Lemma 4.2) and countable, and weights on L are ratios of object values (Lemma 4.13). The descent (Descent.lean) gives one vector on each nonzero deck-homogeneous piece of A₀, closed under composition up to zero (exists_deckVectors); these form a multiplicative basis of A₀ = (Alg F₀)ᵒᵖ containing the primitive idempotents of the labels (exists_multBasis_A0).
